verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs only generically claim to 'calculate and file taxes automatically' (gusto-docs-44) with no explicit description of automated W-2/1099 generation or distribution workflows, so the specific story is thinly evidenced from vendor docs. Community evidence confirms Gusto does produce year-end tax forms but documents a concrete failure case where W-2c corrections combined tax IDs and caused duplicate IRS reporting that went unresolved for months (gusto-comm-1), directly contradicting a smooth 'automatic and correct' experience. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the W-2/1099 generation and distribution workflow, and independent confirmation that the correction/duplicate-reporting issue was an isolated incident rather than a systemic problem.
